phase: Rosetta Research Workbench Phase I Slice 4
purpose: Expose bounded claim/evidence, contradiction/correction registry state, disagreement registry state, and rights-aware media placeholders without creating a second evidence grader or synthesizing unavailable media.

claim_selection.rule: Presentation selection only; claim status, confidence, evidence weight and scientific state remain owned by ACEB.

evidence_rules: Claim text, status, confidence, scope, do-not-overclaim ceilings and alternative explanations are read from ACEB Claims.
Explicit Claim-Evidence Links are shown where registered; missing link rows are labeled as registry absence and are not synthesized.
Contradictions & Corrections and Disagreement Maps are projected only from matching canonical rows.
Zero matching contradiction/disagreement rows means only no matching canonical row is currently registered; it is never evidence that contrary evidence or scientific disagreement does not exist.
The Workbench never re-ranks claims, recalculates confidence, merges competing interpretations into one verdict, or creates semantic glosses.
media_rules: Media placeholders are metadata/provenance surfaces only.
Raw media bytes are never embedded or exposed by the placeholder.
Preview is always disabled unless a future separately governed rights/media authority explicitly permits it.
The Workbench never fabricates thumbnails, substitute images, waveform previews, or reconstructed media when source media is unavailable.
Rights state and missingness/scientific consequence remain visible.

service_contract.claims.list: Return the bounded presentation claim set without re-grading.
service_contract.claims.get: Return one bounded canonical claim projection by Claim_ID.
service_contract.evidence.get: Return hypotheses, claims, corrections, disagreements, registry state, media placeholders, runs and segregated software verification for the active research question.
service_contract.media-placeholders.list: Return metadata-only rights-aware placeholders with bytes_available=false and preview_allowed=false.
service_contract.provenance.get: Resolve claim, claim-evidence-link, correction, disagreement and media-placeholder provenance IDs.

fail_closed_conditions: Evidence-enabled bundle lacks a complete evidence binding.
Evidence item lacks Claim_ID or contains meaning/translation/semantic_gloss/english_gloss fields.
Media-enabled bundle lacks a complete media binding.
Media placeholder exposes bytes or permits preview.
Media placeholder contains media_url, preview_url, image_url or bytes fields.
A zero-row contradiction/disagreement registry state lacks an explicit absence rule.
Any displayed evidence/media provenance identifier is unresolved.
fixture_boundary: The packaged fallback is a bounded presentation fixture derived from the current canonical RQ0001 claim set and D0018/D0020 rights/missingness state; it does not become a second evidence authority.
live_boundary: Full canonical state remains owned by the authenticated canonical producer reading pinned Drive/ACEB authorities; Slice 2 live-auth verification remains a separate operational gate.
